plans.text: Host an art-themed party with stations where guests can create their own art pieces.
Frame the "Moonlit Ocean" digital print and hang it in the bedroom.
Set up an art-books-and-magazines corner featuring publications such as The Artisan Post and Creative Corner to provide inspiration for guests.
Set up a little station where party guests can create their own art journals.
Start an art journal for oneself.
Set up a little station where guests can take photos with fun props and art-themed backdrops.

Create a dreamlike scene with a figure floating in a misty, ethereal environment, using soft pastel colors to evoke calmness and serenity and experimenting with layering and blending techniques to create depth and atmosphere.
Experiment with glazing, soft brushstrokes, and transparent washes to create a sense of mistiness and build up atmosphere.

superseded_plans.text: Work on a piece incorporating a figure in a dreamlike environment, using atmosphere and mood techniques inspired by the "Moonlit Ocean" print.

preferences.text: Interested in exploring surrealism and lowbrow art.
Prefers soft, pastel colors to evoke calmness and serenity.
Likes experimenting with layering and blending techniques to create depth and atmosphere.
